left_defects.source: Wer Abel / Seth / Enoch und Noah? Wer waren die Erzväter?
left_defects.translation: Were Abel, Seth, Enoch, and Noah, who were the patriarchs?

why: Left fuses the two questions before the break into one garbled question; right renders both faithfully and continues cleanly into Doctors.

left_defects.translation: the old man lived on until December 2
he had heard the same from Quesnel own mouth (in person dropped)

why: Both handle the Alterum est | est break correctly, but left drops Quesnel age of 85 and in person just after the break.

left_defects.translation: since he could obtain nothing... / he could obtain nothing, withdrew

why: Left renders the clause split across the break twice; right joins it once without loss.

right_defects.source: toritate Magistratus tam dure flagellas, disce, inquam, ipse non modo de nostris Magistratibus & Principibus bene sentire: sed etiam de iis, quae in eorum actionibus non intelligis ... nequaquam temere iudicare.
right_defects.translation: (nothing; sentence left hanging at neglected authority—)

why: Right drops the entire completion of the sentence crossing the break; left renders it in full.

left_defects.translation: since he could obtain nothing... / he could obtain nothing, withdrew

why: Left duplicates the clause crossing the break; right continues it once (when he could obtain nothing, | having seceded).
Both carry und fuehre | auch selbst ein exemplarisch Leben across the break faithfully with no defect the other lacks.
